items.title: 2165 CABOTS POINT LN RESTON
items.description: This striking contemporary end-unit townhouse in Cabots Point captures the architectural character that makes Reston so distinctive. Wrapped in cedar siding and surrounded by mature trees, the home offers a dramatic, light-filled interior with multiple levels, open sight lines and three private decks that bring the outdoors into everyday living. Step inside to a showstopping open staircase that immediately sets the tone. The main level features an expansive, open-concept living and dining area with views into the lower level and access to two separate outdoor living spaces, perfect for morning coffee, grilling or relaxing beneath the trees. Walls of windows fill the home with natural light while preserving the peaceful, tucked-away feeling of its wooded setting. The kitchen combines warmth and function with rich wood cabinetry, granite countertops, pendant lighting, a white tile backsplash and stainless-steel appliances. An adjoining eat-in area is wrapped in windows overlooking the landscaped, fenced front courtyard with stonework and mature plantings, creating a charming place for casual meals. Upstairs, an open gallery-style hallway is lined with railings and overlooks the levels below, reinforcing the home's dramatic contemporary design. Three generously sized bedrooms feature large windows with leafy, nature-filled views. The primary suite includes a private bathroom with a quartz-topped vanities and walk-in shower, while a second full bathroom is conveniently located between the two additional bedrooms. The walk-out lower level offers even more flexible living space. A spacious family room with a wood-burning fireplace opens through sliding glass doors to the third deck, providing a private outdoor retreat surrounded by greenery. The fourth bedroom also features sliding glass doors to the same deck, making it ideal for guests, a home office or a quiet secondary living space. A half bathroom and access to the two-car garage are half way up the staircase between the main and lower levels. Cabots Point is a distinctive enclave set around beautiful Lake Audubon, known for contemporary cedar homes designed to blend naturally into their surroundings. While this property is not lakefront, it enjoys the peaceful atmosphere and wooded beauty of the lakeside community. South Lakes Village Center, with Safeway, restaurants, coffee and everyday conveniences is nearby, along with the Wiehle--Reston East Metro station and the Silver Line. Residents also enjoy the extensive amenities of Reston Association, including more than 1,300 acres of open space, four lakes, miles of pathways, swimming, tennis, pickleball, recreation programs and community events.

items.title: 1530 KEY BLVD #520 ARLINGTON
items.description: Offering $10k in buyer closing costs for a successful settlement by 10/31! Rarely available two-level residence at The Atrium offering two bedrooms, two full bathrooms, and exceptional flexibility in the heart of Rosslyn. Walls of glass fill the open main level with spectacular treetop views of Northwest DC and The National Cathedral. The spacious living and dining areas flow directly onto a private balcony - an inviting spot for morning coffee, evening drinks, or simply enjoying the view. The upgraded kitchen features granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, generous cabinetry, and breakfast-bar seating. A bedroom and full bathroom on the main level provide an ideal arrangement for guests, a home office, or a nursery. Upstairs, the expansive primary suite enjoys its own full bathroom, abundant closet space, elevated views, and a separate hallway entrance, creating a remarkable degree of privacy and separation. Additional conveniences include a newer washer and dryer, HVAC (2023), tankless water heater, assigned garage parking space, and separate storage unit. The Atrium offers 24-hour front-desk service, an outdoor pool, tennis courts, fitness center, sauna, hot tub, party room, and on-site dry cleaning. Just blocks from the Rosslyn Metro, with easy access to Georgetown, Reagan National Airport, and the GW Parkway. A distinctive, move-in-ready home combining the space of a townhouse with the amenities and convenience of a full-service condominium.

items.title: 1111 19TH ST N #2110 ARLINGTON
items.description: Walk into breathtaking views of the Potomac River from the 21st floor of The Waterview in Rosslyn. This 1 bedroom + den residence features floor-to-ceiling windows that fill the home with natural light and showcase dramatic river and Georgetown views. The open kitchen includes a large island, granite countertops, and high-end appliances including SubZero, Viking, and Bosch. Hardwood floors run through the main living areas, creating a seamless space for everyday living and entertaining. The den, located just off the foyer, is perfect for a home office. The spacious bedroom features floor-to-ceiling windows, generous closet space, and brand new carpet. Gas, heat, water, and sewer are included in the condo fee, leaving only electricity and internet as additional utilities. The Waterview offers luxury, hotel-style living with a 24-hour concierge, fitness center, and a spectacular residents-only rooftop terrace with panoramic views of the Potomac River and Washington, DC monuments. Residents also have access to select services from the Le Méridien Hotel located in the building. Located just steps from the Rosslyn Metro, Key Bridge, Georgetown, riverfront trails, restaurants, and shops, this condo offers a rare combination of luxury, convenience, and iconic views.

items.title: 900 N STAFFORD ST #1805 ARLINGTON
items.description: High above the heart of Ballston, Unit 1805 at the Alta Vista offers a spacious three-bedroom, two-bath layout with stylish finishes, flexible living spaces and sweeping western views. The kitchen features black granite countertops, black appliances and beautiful medium-stained Shaker-style cabinetry. A striking blue-green glass tile backsplash adds color and personality, while the breakfast bar opens directly to the main living area, keeping the kitchen connected while providing ample workspace. Wood laminate floors extend throughout the expansive living room and dedicated dining area, creating plenty of room for everyday living and entertaining. The living space flows into the west-facing sunroom, where large windows capture abundant afternoon light and colorful evening sunsets. Whether used as a sitting area, home office or quiet place to unwind, the sunroom adds another dimension to the home. The first bedroom is conveniently located just off the dining area and features newly installed luxury vinyl flooring. Down the hallway, a second bedroom also offers new luxury vinyl floors along with direct access to the sunroom. A full bathroom is located just across the hall, making this versatile room ideal for guests, a home office or a combination of both. At the end of the hallway, the private primary suite provides a comfortable retreat with new luxury vinyl flooring and multiple closets, including a walk-in closet. The en-suite bathroom features a modern vessel sink set above a black granite countertop. One assigned garage parking space and a private extra-storage unit convey. Additional garage parking is also available to rent, offering valuable flexibility for a multi-car household. Residents of the Altavista enjoy a 24-hour front desk, fitness center, community room and direct access to the Ballston Metro without having to step outside. Ballston Quarter, restaurants, shopping, entertainment and everyday conveniences are all just moments away. With three true bedrooms, generous living space and beautiful western exposure, Unit 1805 offers a rare combination of space, convenience and city living.

items.title: 900 N STAFFORD ST #1719 ARLINGTON
items.description: Welcome to Unit 1719 at the Alta Vista, a beautifully updated corner unit two-bedroom, two-bath residence offering 1,005 square feet of comfortable living space in the heart of Ballston. Light bamboo hardwood floors and fresh paint create a bright, inviting feel throughout the main living areas. The kitchen features abundant cabinetry, generous counter space and a breakfast bar that opens to the living and dining areas, perfect for casual meals and entertaining alike. Just beyond the living room, the enclosed sunroom provides valuable additional living space and showcases northern and eastern panoramic views overlooking the Ballston Metro. It is an ideal setting for a home office, reading nook or a quiet place to unwind above the activity of the neighborhood. Bedrooms are thoughtfully positioned on opposite sides of the living space, creating privacy and flexibility for guests, roommates or working from home. Each bedroom is conveniently paired with its own updated full bathroom, making the split-bedroom floor plan especially functional. One amazing garage parking space next to the elevator and a private extra-storage unit #1719 on the same floor as the condo convey. Additional garage parking is also available to rent in the garage. Residents of the Altavista enjoy a secure building with a 24-hour front desk, fitness center, community room and one of Ballston's most convenient locations. Direct access to the Ballston Metro means you can begin your commute without stepping outside, while Ballston Quarter, restaurants, shopping, fitness studios and everyday conveniences are all just moments away. Unit 1719 combines an efficient two-bedroom layout, elevated views and an unbeatable Metro-connected location, offering the ease and energy of true Ballston living.

items.title: 888 N QUINCY ST #1105 ARLINGTON
items.description: Welcome to Unit 1105, a beautifully appointed one-bedroom Revere model in the sought-after Residences at Liberty Center. Light oak hardwood floors create a bright, contemporary feel throughout the main living area, complemented by floor-to-ceiling glass and abundant natural light. The gourmet kitchen features granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, abundant light maple cabinetry, and a breakfast bar accented by pendant lighting. The open layout flows seamlessly into a dedicated dining area and spacious living room, where floor-to-ceiling sliding glass doors open to a private 11th-floor balcony--an ideal extension of the living space. The generously sized bedroom is comfortably carpeted with plenty of room for a king-size bed and features both a large walk-in closet and an additional secondary closet. The bedroom connects directly to the dual-entry bathroom, complete with a spacious granite-topped vanity and a tub/shower combination, while also providing convenient access from the main living area. Garage parking space #466 and private storage unit #313 convey. Residents of Liberty Center enjoy one of Ballston's premier luxury condominium lifestyles, with amenities including 24-hour concierge service, a spectacular rooftop terrace with panoramic views of Washington, DC and its monuments, a rooftop pool, and a state-of-the-art fitness center. Ideally located just three blocks from the Ballston Metro and surrounded by restaurants, shopping, entertainment, and everything the Ballston-Rosslyn corridor has to offer, Unit #1105 combines comfort, convenience, and contemporary style in one of Arlington's most desirable locations. Modern, refined, and exceptionally well located, this is elevated urban living in the heart of Ballston.
